prompt: Subject: Morning bedroom unwinding in light Main Focus: one young adult female sitting on a white bed in a wood-toned bedroom with morning sun entering through shoji and a large window. Character placed large in the center, focusing from face to bent legs, ivory camisole with sheer wrap, and pale greige shorts. Person/Expression: Small rounded oval face, bright smooth skin, dark brown almond eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, glossy pale rose slightly parted lips. Tilted slightly left looking sleepily at the camera with shoulders shrugged. Long lashes, thin eyeliner, faint redness on cheeks and around eyes. Loose straight dark brown hair reaching below chest, long thin bangs and strands over face, hair falling over left shoulder. Clothing/Pose: ivory thin-strap camisole top, white sheer lace long-sleeve robe, pale greige pink soft shorts. Sitting on bed with left leg extended forward and right knee bent inward. Supporting body with hands on bedding, leaning slightly forward. Background/Light: Large black-framed glass window and white shoji on the left, soft blurred greenery outside. Low wooden storage, white round table lamp, small bottles and frames in back right. Foreground and right side show wrinkled white duvet and pillows. Warm direct morning light from the back-left window illuminates hair edges, cheeks, chest, left sleeve, and thighs diagonally. Soft diffused light inside leaves shadows. Composition/Camera: 2:3 vertical. Near sitting portrait from a camera at bed height. Head in top-center, torso in center, thighs and bent legs occupying the bottom half. Hands near bottom edges. Precise focus on face and chest with shallow depth of field blurring the room background. Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic photo in natural morning light. Depicts natural skin texture and fine glow, back-lit hair strands, rib knit, lace transparency, soft shorts, wrinkled white bedding, wood, and glass. Quiet tones of white, beige, and pale pink, avoiding excessive smoothing or illustration style. Negative: Alteration of facial features, hairstyle, off-shoulder robe, or sitting posture on bed.

promptZh: 主体：清晨卧室的惬意时光 核心焦点：一位年轻女性 坐在白色床上，身处木质调卧室，清晨的阳光透过障子和落地大窗洒入。人物居中，构图聚焦于面部到弯曲的双腿，身着象牙白吊带衫搭配透明罩衫，以及浅灰褐色短裤。人物/表情：圆润的小鹅蛋脸，明亮光滑的皮肤，深棕色杏仁眼，天然细眉，小巧鼻梁，光泽感淡粉色微张双唇。头部微向左倾，睡眼惺忪地看向镜头，双肩微耸。长睫毛，细眼线，脸颊和眼周泛着淡淡红晕。深棕色直长发垂至胸下，细长的刘海和发丝散落在脸庞，发丝垂在左肩。服装/姿势：象牙白细肩带吊带衫，白色透明蕾丝长袖罩衫，浅灰粉色柔软短裤。坐在床上，左腿向前伸展，右膝向内弯曲。双手撑在床褥上支撑身体，身体微微前倾。背景/光影：左侧为大型黑色边框玻璃窗和白色障子，窗外是模糊的绿植。右后方有低矮木质储物柜、白色圆形台灯、小瓶子和相框。前景和右侧展示了褶皱的白色被褥和枕头。来自左后方窗户的温暖直射晨光，照亮了发丝边缘、脸颊、胸部、左袖和斜向的大腿。室内柔和的漫射光留下了阴影。构图/相机：2:3 纵向比例。在床位高度拍摄的近距离坐姿肖像。头部位于顶部中心，躯干位于中心，大腿和弯曲的双腿占据下半部分。双手靠近底部边缘。焦点精准对准面部和胸部，浅景深使房间背景虚化。质感/风格：自然晨光下的高清写实照片。呈现自然的皮肤纹理和细腻光泽、逆光发丝、罗纹针织、蕾丝透明感、柔软短裤、褶皱白色床品、木材和玻璃。色调为安静的白色、米色和淡粉色，避免过度磨皮或插画风格。负面提示：改变面部特征、发型、露肩罩衫或床上的坐姿。
